1	//! The seam between the server binary and a model crate.
2	//!
3	//! A model line is everything south of the engine contract: config probing,
4	//! its own CLI knobs, and a `launch` that starts scheduler threads and hands
5	//! back a [`LaunchedEngine`]. The server binary holds a feature-gated
6	//! [`ModelLineRegistry`] and does pure dispatch — it never names a model
7	//! crate's option types.
8	//!
9	//! Onboarding a model line means implementing [`ModelLine`] in the model
10	//! crate and adding the instance to the registry in the server binary. No
11	//! other server edits: argument routing, consume-or-reject validation, and
12	//! config detection all derive from the trait.
13	
14	use std::collections::BTreeMap;
15	use std::collections::BTreeSet;
16	use std::path::Path;
17	use std::path::PathBuf;
18	
19	use vllm_chat::ParserSelection;
20	
21	use crate::engine::LaunchedEngine;
22	use crate::vllm::LoraModule;
23	
24	/// Model detection failed. The server branches on [`DetectError::NoMatch`]
25	/// to append a feature-gate hint for families that exist but were compiled
26	/// out; everything else just renders.
27	#[derive(Debug, thiserror::Error)]
28	pub enum DetectError {
29	    #[error("model config claimed by both {first} and {second}")]
30	    Conflict {
31	        first: &'static str,
32	        second: &'static str,
33	    },
34	    #[error(
35	        "no compiled-in model line claims this config (model_type={model_type}, architectures={architectures}); rejections: {}",
36	        rejections.join("; ")
37	    )]
38	    NoMatch {
39	        /// `model_type` from config.json, rendered verbatim (or `missing`).
40	        model_type: String,
41	        /// `architectures` from config.json, rendered verbatim (or `missing`).
42	        architectures: String,
43	        /// One `<line>: <reason>` entry per compiled-in line.
44	        rejections: Vec<String>,
45	    },
46	}
47	
48	/// A CLI-level rejection: the flag set is well-formed for clap but invalid
49	/// for the detected model line.
50	#[derive(Debug, thiserror::Error)]
51	pub enum CliError {
52	    /// A provided flag is neither core, nor shared-and-consumed, nor one of
53	    /// the detected line's own flags.
54	    #[error("--{flag} is not used by {line}")]
55	    UnconsumedFlag { flag: String, line: &'static str },
56	    /// A line-specific cross-flag rule was violated. The message is the
57	    /// user-facing explanation; rules are prose, not a taxonomy.
58	    #[error("{0}")]
59	    Rule(String),
60	}
61	
62	impl CliError {
63	    pub fn rule(message: impl Into<String>) -> Self {
64	        Self::Rule(message.into())
65	    }
66	}
67	
68	/// Flags accepted for every model line regardless of detected type.
69	const CORE_ARGS: &[&str] = &[
70	    "model_path",
71	    "served_model_name",
72	    "port",
73	    "tool_call_parser",
74	];
75	
76	/// A source argument id and the argument ids it requires.
77	pub type ArgRequirement = (&'static str, &'static [&'static str]);
78	
79	const DEFAULT_MODEL_PATH: &str = concat!(env!("CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR"), "/../models/Qwen3-4B");
80	
81	/// Shared CLI selector for model lines that can overlap prefill and decode.
82	#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Default, Eq, PartialEq, clap::ValueEnum)]
83	pub enum CliDecodeOverlap {
84	    /// One stream; prefill and decode serialize.
85	    #[default]
86	    Off,
87	    /// Two CUDA streams sharing all SMs.
88	    Stream,
89	    /// Green Context SM partition (SM-pinned streams).
90	    #[value(name = "green-ctx")]
91	    GreenCtx,
92	}
93	
94	// CLI flags shared by more than one model line. Each line declares the
95	// subset it reads via `ModelLine::consumed_shared_args`; providing a flag
96	// outside that subset fails validation with a per-line error.
97	// (Regular comment: a doc comment here would override the command about.)
98	#[derive(Debug, clap::Args)]
99	#[allow(clippy::struct_excessive_bools)] // independent CLI flags, not a state machine
100	pub struct SharedArgs {
101	    /// Model directory containing config, tokenizer, and safetensor shards
102	    #[arg(long, default_value = DEFAULT_MODEL_PATH)]
103	    pub model_path: PathBuf,
104	
105	    /// Public model ID returned by the OpenAI API (/v1/models, completion `model`).
106	    /// Defaults to the model path when omitted.
107	    #[arg(long)]
108	    pub served_model_name: Option<String>,
109	
110	    /// Port to listen on
111	    #[arg(long, default_value_t = 8000)]
112	    pub port: u16,
113	
114	    /// Tool-call output parser: `auto` (match the model), `none`, or an explicit
115	    /// registered parser name such as `qwen3_coder`. Upstream `auto` matches the
116	    /// model *path* by substring; a line whose checkpoints share one tool format
117	    /// can resolve `auto` to that parser itself (see `ServePlan`), so the
118	    /// directory name no longer decides.
119	    #[arg(long, default_value_t = ParserSelection::Auto)]
120	    pub tool_call_parser: ParserSelection,
121	
122	    /// Enable CUDA Graph capture/replay on decode path (`--cuda-graph=false` to
123	    /// disable). Rejected for GLM5.2; forced off in Qwen3 LoRA mode; Qwen3.5
124	    /// always captures and rejects `false`; dense Gemma 4 captures per batch
125	    /// bucket while routed checkpoints warn and serve eagerly.
126	    #[arg(long, default_value_t = true, action = clap::ArgAction::Set)]
127	    pub cuda_graph: bool,
128	
129	    /// Dump a live rank-0 decode CUDA Graph during startup. Qwen3 exports its
130	    /// batch-1 SplitKv graph; GLM5.2 exports EP bucket 1 selected by
131	    /// `--moe-topo`. Writes a complete sibling `.dot` for machine inspection
132	    /// and a folded Graphviz PNG at this path. Requires CUDA driver API 12.3
133	    /// or newer for kernel-name inspection.
134	    #[arg(long)]
135	    pub dump_graph_png: Option<PathBuf>,
136	
137	    /// CUDA device ordinal for single-GPU Qwen3/Qwen3.5 loads
138	    #[arg(long, default_value_t = 0)]
139	    pub device_ordinal: usize,
140	
141	    /// Tensor-parallel world size. GLM5.2 supports TP1/EP8 today; TP4/GB300
142	    /// bring-up uses --tp-size=4 --moe-topo=tp4.
143	    #[arg(long, default_value_t = 1)]
144	    pub tp_size: usize,
145	
146	    /// Data-parallel world size. Kimi-K2 and GLM5.2 EP8 default to 8;
147	    /// GLM5.2 TP4 defaults to 1.
148	    #[arg(long)]
149	    pub dp_size: Option<usize>,
150	
151	    /// Enable pegaflow KV offload (host-tier "L2" cache): single-GPU Qwen3,
152	    /// or GLM5.2 DP8 (one pool shared by all 8 ranks under one namespace).
153	    /// Sealed KV blocks are saved to host pinned memory and restored into
154	    /// HBM before prefill when a prompt's prefix has fallen out of the GPU
155	    /// cache. GLM5.2 requires the prefix cache: incompatible with
156	    /// --no-prefix-cache and speculative decoding.
157	    #[arg(long, default_value_t = false)]
158	    pub kv_offload: bool,
159	
160	    /// Host pinned-memory pool size for the KV offload tier, in GiB. pegaflow
161	    /// allocates the whole pool up front, so RSS reflects this at startup.
162	    #[arg(long, default_value_t = 8.0, value_parser = parse_offload_gib)]
163	    pub kv_offload_host_gib: f64,
164	
165	    /// Back the KV offload pool with 2 MiB hugepages. The box must hold a
166	    /// reservation covering the pool (`HugePages_Total` in /proc/meminfo;
167	    /// `echo N > /proc/sys/vm/nr_hugepages` as root) — allocation fails at
168	    /// startup otherwise.
169	    #[arg(long, default_value_t = false)]
170	    pub kv_offload_hugepages: bool,
171	
172	    /// Join the cross-instance KV P2P mesh: pegaflow MetaServer gRPC address
173	    /// (e.g. `http://127.0.0.1:50056`). Saved block hashes register there and
174	    /// missing prefixes are pulled from peer instances over RDMA — the P/D
175	    /// disaggregation data plane. Requires --kv-offload, --kv-p2p-advertise-addr
176	    /// and --kv-p2p-nics.
177	    #[arg(long)]
178	    pub kv_p2p_metaserver_addr: Option<String>,
179	
180	    /// This instance's routable IP:port for KV P2P — a literal socket address
181	    /// (it is also the embedded transfer-service bind address, so hostnames
182	    /// are rejected at startup). Peers dial it for RDMA handshakes and block
183	    /// queries. Must be reachable by every peer; not 0.0.0.0.
184	    #[arg(long)]
185	    pub kv_p2p_advertise_addr: Option<String>,
186	
187	    /// RDMA NIC device names for KV P2P (e.g. `mlx5_0`), comma-separated.
188	    #[arg(long, value_delimiter = ',')]
189	    pub kv_p2p_nics: Vec<String>,
190	
191	    /// vLLM-style no-prefix-cache. Without --kv-offload it disables prefix
192	    /// matching outright (every prefill recomputes the full prompt). With
193	    /// --kv-offload it is the pure-L2 mode: no cross-request HBM reuse, so every
194	    /// prefix is restored from the host tier — for measuring the L2 TTFT win.
195	    #[arg(long, default_value_t = false)]
196	    pub no_prefix_cache: bool,
197	
198	    /// Speculative drafter model path: Qwen3 DFlash/DSpark decoding, or the
199	    /// GLM5.2 DSpark drafter (greedy AND sampled requests speculate;
200	    /// per-request accept stats logged). For Qwen3: single-GPU greedy only;
201	    /// incompatible with --enable-lora and --kv-offload, and forces the
202	    /// prefix cache off (it needs clean target hidden states).
203	    #[arg(long = "dflash-draft-model-path")]
204	    pub dflash_draft_model_path: Option<PathBuf>,
205	
206	    /// Cap on total prompt tokens forwarded in one scheduler step. Qwen3 and
207	    /// Qwen3.5 only (rejected for other model lines); when omitted, they use
208	    /// their own crate defaults.
209	    #[arg(long)]
210	    pub max_prefill_tokens: Option<usize>,
211	
212	    /// How prefill and decode share the GPU. Qwen3 supports `off`, `stream`,
213	    /// and `green-ctx`; Qwen3.5 supports `off` and `stream`.
214	    #[arg(long, value_enum, default_value_t = CliDecodeOverlap::Off)]
215	    pub decode_overlap: CliDecodeOverlap,
216	
217	    /// Percent of SMs pinned to decode in `--decode-overlap green-ctx` (the rest
218	    /// go to prefill); rejected if set in any other mode.
219	    #[arg(long, default_value_t = 20, value_parser = clap::value_parser!(u32).range(1..=99))]
220	    pub decode_sm_pct: u32,
221	}
222	
223	const SHARED_ARG_REQUIREMENTS: &[ArgRequirement] = &[
224	    ("kv_offload_host_gib", &["kv_offload"]),
225	    ("kv_offload_hugepages", &["kv_offload"]),
226	    (
227	        "kv_p2p_metaserver_addr",
228	        &["kv_offload", "kv_p2p_advertise_addr", "kv_p2p_nics"],
229	    ),
230	    ("kv_p2p_advertise_addr", &["kv_p2p_metaserver_addr"]),
231	    ("kv_p2p_nics", &["kv_p2p_metaserver_addr"]),
232	];
233	
234	impl SharedArgs {
235	    /// Interactions between shared flags that hold for every consumer.
236	    /// Line-specific rules live in each line's [`ModelLine::validate`].
237	    pub fn validate(&self, provided: &BTreeSet<String>) -> Result<(), CliError> {
238	        if self.dump_graph_png.is_some() && !self.cuda_graph {
239	            return Err(CliError::rule(
240	                "--dump-graph-png requires --cuda-graph=true",
241	            ));
242	        }
243	        if provided.contains("device_ordinal") && self.tp_size > 1 {
244	            return Err(CliError::rule(
245	                "--device-ordinal is ignored under tensor parallelism; tp_size>1 uses devices 0..tp_size",
246	            ));
247	        }
248	        if provided.contains("decode_sm_pct") && self.decode_overlap != CliDecodeOverlap::GreenCtx {
249	            return Err(CliError::rule(
250	                "--decode-sm-pct only applies with --decode-overlap=green-ctx",
251	            ));
252	        }
253	        // An explicit parser name is taken verbatim by `FromStr`, so only the
254	        // registry can tell a typo from a real parser. Check it here, before an
255	        // engine load is spent on a request that could never be parsed.
256	        vllm_chat::validate_parser_overrides(&self.tool_call_parser, &ParserSelection::Auto)
257	            .map_err(|error| CliError::rule(format!("invalid --tool-call-parser: {error}")))?;
258	        Ok(())
259	    }
260	}
261	
262	fn parse_offload_gib(value: &str) -> Result<f64, String> {
263	    let gib = value
264	        .parse::<f64>()
265	        .map_err(|error| format!("invalid --kv-offload-host-gib: {error}"))?;
266	    if gib.is_finite() && gib > 0.0 {
267	        Ok(gib)
268	    } else {
269	        Err("--kv-offload-host-gib must be a positive, finite number of GiB".to_owned())
270	    }
271	}

273	/// Everything `launch` and `serve_plan` may read.
274	pub struct LaunchContext<'a> {
275	    /// Model directory containing `config.json` and weights.
276	    pub model_path: &'a Path,
277	    /// Parsed `config.json` — the same value `probe` accepted.
278	    pub config: &'a serde_json::Value,
279	    /// Shared flags (the line reads only its consumed subset).
280	    pub shared: &'a SharedArgs,
281	    /// Full parse of the merged command; the line recovers its exclusive
282	    /// flags with `<Cli as clap::FromArgMatches>::from_arg_matches`.
283	    pub matches: &'a clap::ArgMatches,
284	}
285	
286	/// What the frontend must know before (and independently of) the engine
287	/// finishing its load.
288	///
289	/// Lines should build their plan with `..ServePlan::default()` and spell only
290	/// what they set: CI compiles three model lines, so an exhaustive literal in
291	/// any other crate breaks on the next field added here and nothing catches it
292	/// until that crate is checked by hand.
293	pub struct ServePlan {
294	    /// Scheduler partitions (logical DP ranks) the launched engine will
295	    /// expose. The HTTP frontend registers one engine identity per partition
296	    /// *while the engine is still loading*, so this must be derivable from
297	    /// CLI flags alone. Checked against

299	    pub scheduler_partition_count: usize,

301	    pub prefill_only: bool,

396	impl std::fmt::Display for ArgOwner {
397	    fn fmt(&self, f: &mut std::fmt::Formatter<'_>) -> std::fmt::Result {

405	#[derive(Default)]
406	struct RegistryClaims {
407	    ids: BTreeMap<String, ArgOwner>,
408	    spellings: BTreeMap<String, ArgOwner>,
409	}
410	
411	impl RegistryClaims {
412	    fn register_command(&mut self, command: &clap::Command, owner: ArgOwner) -> BTreeSet<String> {
413	        command
414	            .get_arguments()
415	            .map(|arg| self.register_arg(arg, owner))
416	            .collect()
417	    }
418	
419	    fn register_arg(&mut self, arg: &clap::Arg, owner: ArgOwner) -> String {
420	        let id = arg.get_id().to_string();
421	        self.claim_id(id.clone(), owner);
422	        for long in arg
423	            .get_long()
424	            .into_iter()
425	            .chain(arg.get_all_aliases().into_iter().flatten())
426	        {
427	            self.claim_spelling(format!("--{long}"), owner);
428	        }
429	        for short in arg
430	            .get_short()
431	            .into_iter()
432	            .chain(arg.get_all_short_aliases().into_iter().flatten())
433	        {
434	            self.claim_spelling(format!("-{short}"), owner);
435	        }
436	        id
437	    }
438	
439	    fn claim_id(&mut self, id: String, owner: ArgOwner) {
440	        if let Some(previous) = self.ids.get(&id) {
441	            if *previous == ArgOwner::Shared {
442	                if let ArgOwner::Line(name) = owner {
443	                    panic!(
444	                        "model line {name} redeclares SharedArgs flag id {id:?}; list it in consumed_shared_args instead"
445	                    );
446	                }
447	            }
448	            panic!("{previous} and {owner} both define flag id {id:?}");
449	        }
450	        self.ids.insert(id, owner);
451	    }
452	
453	    fn claim_spelling(&mut self, spelling: String, owner: ArgOwner) {
454	        if let Some(previous) = self.spellings.get(&spelling) {
455	            panic!("{previous} and {owner} both define CLI spelling {spelling:?}");
456	        }
457	        self.spellings.insert(spelling, owner);
458	    }
459	
460	    fn is_shared_id(&self, id: &str) -> bool {
461	        self.ids.get(id) == Some(&ArgOwner::Shared)
462	    }
463	
464	    fn validate_requirement(&self, owner: ArgOwner, source: &str, targets: &[&str]) {
465	        assert!(
466	            self.ids.get(source) == Some(&owner),
467	            "{owner} declares requirements for unowned flag id {source:?}"
468	        );
469	        for &target in targets {
470	            assert!(source != target, "flag id {source:?} cannot require itself");
471	            let target_owner = self.ids.get(target);
472	            assert!(
473	                target_owner == Some(&ArgOwner::Shared) || target_owner == Some(&owner),
474	                "{owner} flag id {source:?} requires unknown or foreign argument id {target:?}"
475	            );
476	        }
477	    }
478	}
479	
480	fn register_line(
481	    line: &'static dyn ModelLine,
482	    owner: ArgOwner,
483	    claims: &mut RegistryClaims,
484	) -> LineEntry {
485	    for id in line.consumed_shared_args() {
486	        assert!(
487	            claims.is_shared_id(id),
488	            "model line {} consumes unknown SharedArgs flag id {id:?}",
489	            line.name()
490	        );
491	    }
492	    let command = line.augment_cli(clap::Command::new("probe"));
493	    let own_ids = claims.register_command(&command, owner);
494	    LineEntry { line, own_ids }
495	}

497	/// The server binary's fixed list of compiled-in model lines.
498	pub struct ModelLineRegistry {
499	    entries: Vec<LineEntry>,
500	    requirements: BTreeMap<&'static str, &'static [&'static str]>,
501	}
502	
503	impl ModelLineRegistry {
504	    /// Validates CLI ownership explicitly because Clap's equivalent schema
505	    /// assertions are disabled in release builds.
506	    pub fn new(lines: Vec<&'static dyn ModelLine>) -> Self {
507	        let shared_cmd = SharedArgs::augment_args(clap::Command::new("probe"));
508	        let mut claims = RegistryClaims::default();
509	        claims.register_command(&shared_cmd, ArgOwner::Shared);
510	        for id in CORE_ARGS {
511	            assert!(
512	                claims.is_shared_id(id),
513	                "CORE_ARGS contains unknown SharedArgs flag id {id:?}"
514	            );
515	        }
516	        let mut pending_requirements = SHARED_ARG_REQUIREMENTS
517	            .iter()
518	            .map(|&(source, targets)| (ArgOwner::Shared, source, targets))
519	            .collect::<Vec<_>>();
520	        let mut entries = Vec::with_capacity(lines.len());
521	        let mut line_names = BTreeSet::new();
522	        for line in lines {
523	            let name = line.name();
524	            assert!(
525	                line_names.insert(name),
526	                "duplicate model line name {name:?}"
527	            );
528	            let owner = ArgOwner::Line(name);
529	            entries.push(register_line(line, owner, &mut claims));
530	            pending_requirements.extend(
531	                line.arg_requirements()
532	                    .iter()
533	                    .map(|&(source, targets)| (owner, source, targets)),
534	            );
535	        }
536	        let mut requirements = BTreeMap::new();
537	        for (owner, source, targets) in pending_requirements {
538	            claims.validate_requirement(owner, source, targets);
539	            assert!(
540	                requirements.insert(source, targets).is_none(),
541	                "{owner} declares requirements more than once for flag id {source:?}"
542	            );
543	        }
544	        Self {
545	            entries,
546	            requirements,
547	        }
548	    }
549	
550	    /// The full server command: shared flags plus every line's exclusive
551	    /// flags, so `--help` and parsing don't depend on the detected model.
552	    pub fn build_command(&self, cmd: clap::Command) -> clap::Command {
553	        let mut cmd = SharedArgs::augment_args(cmd);
554	        for entry in &self.entries {
555	            cmd = entry.line.augment_cli(cmd);
556	        }
557	        // `mut_arg` re-appends each source and would reorder `--help`.
558	        cmd.mut_args(|arg| {
559	            let Some(targets) = self.requirements.get(arg.get_id().as_str()) else {
560	                return arg;
561	            };
562	            arg.requires_all(targets.iter().copied())
563	        })
564	    }

566	    /// Find the unique line that claims this `config.json`. On
567	    /// [`DetectError::NoMatch`] the caller may prepend a hint for families
568	    /// that exist but were compiled out.
569	    pub fn detect(
570	        &self,
571	        config: &serde_json::Value,
572	    ) -> Result<&'static dyn ModelLine, DetectError> {
573	        let mut rejections = Vec::new();
574	        let mut claimed: Option<&'static dyn ModelLine> = None;
575	        for entry in &self.entries {
576	            match entry.line.probe(config) {
577	                Ok(()) => match claimed {
578	                    None => claimed = Some(entry.line),
579	                    Some(prev) => {
580	                        return Err(DetectError::Conflict {
581	                            first: prev.name(),
582	                            second: entry.line.name(),
583	                        });
584	                    }
585	                },
586	                Err(reason) => rejections.push(format!("{}: {reason}", entry.line.name())),
587	            }
588	        }
589	        claimed.ok_or_else(|| {
590	            let render = |key: &str| {
591	                config
592	                    .get(key)
593	                    .map_or_else(|| "missing".to_string(), std::string::ToString::to_string)
594	            };
595	            DetectError::NoMatch {
596	                model_type: render("model_type"),
597	                architectures: render("architectures"),
598	                rejections,
599	            }
600	        })
601	    }
602	
603	    /// Consume-or-reject: every explicitly provided flag must be a core flag,
604	    /// a shared flag the detected line consumes, or one of the line's own.
605	    pub fn validate_provided(
606	        &self,
607	        detected: &'static dyn ModelLine,
608	        provided: &BTreeSet<String>,
609	        cmd: &clap::Command,
610	    ) -> Result<(), CliError> {
611	        let entry = self
612	            .entries
613	            .iter()
614	            .find(|entry| std::ptr::eq(entry.line, detected))
615	            .expect("detected line came from this registry");
616	        for id in provided {
617	            let id = id.as_str();
618	            if CORE_ARGS.contains(&id)
619	                || detected.consumed_shared_args().contains(&id)
620	                || entry.own_ids.contains(id)
621	            {
622	                continue;
623	            }
624	            return Err(CliError::UnconsumedFlag {
625	                flag: long_flag(cmd, id),
626	                line: detected.name(),
627	            });
628	        }
629	        Ok(())
630	    }
631	}
632	
633	fn long_flag(cmd: &clap::Command, id: &str) -> String {
634	    cmd.get_arguments()
635	        .find(|arg| arg.get_id() == id)
636	        .and_then(clap::Arg::get_long)
637	        .map_or_else(|| id.to_owned(), str::to_owned)
638	}

640	/// Arg ids the user set explicitly (command line or env), for consume-or-reject.
641	pub fn provided_args(matches: &clap::ArgMatches, cmd: &clap::Command) -> BTreeSet<String> {
642	    // matches.ids() also yields clap's synthetic group ids; keep only real args.
643	    let real: BTreeSet<&str> = cmd
644	        .get_arguments()
645	        .map(|arg| arg.get_id().as_str())
646	        .collect();
647	    matches
648	        .ids()
649	        .map(clap::Id::as_str)
650	        .filter(|id| real.contains(id))
651	        .filter(|id| {
652	            matches!(
653	                matches.value_source(id),
654	                Some(
655	                    clap::parser::ValueSource::CommandLine | clap::parser::ValueSource::EnvVariable
656	                )
657	            )
658	        })
659	        .map(str::to_owned)
660	        .collect()
661	}

665	/// Test helper: parse `argv` against shared flags plus one line's flags, the
666	/// way the server binary does for a detected line. Exposed for model-crate
667	/// unit tests; not a serving entry point.
668	pub fn parse_for_line(
669	    line: &'static dyn ModelLine,
670	    argv: &[&str],
671	) -> anyhow::Result<(SharedArgs, clap::ArgMatches, BTreeSet<String>)> {
672	    use clap::FromArgMatches;
673	    let registry = ModelLineRegistry::new(vec![line]);
674	    let cmd = registry.build_command(clap::Command::new("pegainfer"));
675	    let matches = cmd.clone().try_get_matches_from(argv)?;
676	    let shared = SharedArgs::from_arg_matches(&matches)?;
677	    let provided = provided_args(&matches, &cmd);
678	    registry.validate_provided(line, &provided, &cmd)?;
679	    shared.validate(&provided)?;
680	    Ok((shared, matches, provided))
681	}

2	//!

4	//! step carries at most one [`RequestUpdate`] — a flat record rather than an
5	//! event sequence, so the intra-step ordering rules of the old `TokenEvent`
6	//! protocol (`Scheduled` before tokens before a single terminal) are structure,
7	//! not convention: a `RequestUpdate` cannot express a token after its terminal.
8	//! Cross-step ordering is enforced on the producer side by the
9	//! [`super::RequestLedger`]: a request's account closes at its terminal, and
10	//! writes against a closed account panic.

21	/// [`super::SchedulerHandle::submit`] from a per-scheduler counter. `Copy` and
22	/// integer-keyed on purpose: the external protocol's string request id stays in
23	/// the protocol stack, which maps it to this id at its own boundary.
24	#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Eq, Hash, Ord, PartialEq, PartialOrd)]
25	pub struct RequestId(u64);

28	    /// Minting ids is [`super::SchedulerHandle::submit`]'s job in production
29	    /// (a per-scheduler counter). Public so scheduler unit tests and tools
30	    /// can fabricate requests.
31	    pub fn new(raw: u64) -> Self {
32	        Self(raw)
33	    }
34	
35	    /// Raw counter value, for logs and protocol-side maps.
36	    #[must_use]
37	    pub fn raw(self) -> u64 {
38	        self.0
39	    }
40	}

44	        write!(f, "req-{}", self.0)
45	    }
46	}

Quickstart · Performance · Models · Architecture · API · Development

PegaInfer serves LLMs through an OpenAI-compatible API. Each model owns its scheduler, state, and kernels; serving and KV infrastructure are shared. No PyTorch or Python runtime. ## Quickstart ### Prebuilt binary · Qwen3 on Linux The Qwen3-only release bundles CUDA 13 and cuBLAS. It requires **Linux x86_64**, an NVIDIA GPU with compute capability **8.x–12.x**, driver **580+**, glibc **2.35+**, and OpenSSL **3**. Model weights are downloaded separately. ```bash curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pegainfer-project/pegainfer/main/install.sh | bash ``` Download [Qwen3-4B](https://huggingface.co/Qwen/Qwen3-4B) into `models/Qwen3-4B`, then start the server: ```bash pegainfer --model-path models/Qwen3-4B ``` The server listens on port **8000**. If the command is not on your shell's path: ```bash export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH" ``` The installer selects the latest release by default. `PEGAINFER_VERSION` selects an exact version; see [releases](https://github.com/pegainfer-project/pegainfer/releases). ### Build from source Use the Rust toolchain pinned in [rust-toolchain.toml](rust-toolchain.toml), a CUDA Toolkit with `nvcc` and cuBLAS, and a compatible NVIDIA driver. The default Qwen3 build needs no Python. Its driver floor is R545 / CUDA 12.3; newer toolkits and model-specific kernels can require a newer driver. From the repository root, with the checkpoint downloaded: ```bash export CUDA_HOME=/usr/local/cuda cargo run --release -- --model-path models/Qwen3-4B ``` Always use **`--release`** for GPU builds. The server entrypoint is `pegainfer-server`; model crates contain the model implementation and diagnostics.
Feature builds and environment options Qwen3.5 uses Triton AOT kernels, requiring Python and Triton at build time: ```bash uv venv uv pip install triton export PEGAINFER_TRITON_PYTHON=.venv/bin/python cargo run --release --features qwen35 -- --model-path models/Qwen3.5-4B ```

36	#[allow(clippy::struct_excessive_bools)] // independent CLI flags, not a state machine

38	    /// Enable Qwen3 LoRA serving mode.
39	    #[arg(long, default_value_t = false)]
40	    enable_lora: bool,
41	
42	    /// LoRA modules to load at startup. Accepts vLLM-style `name=path`, JSON
43	    /// object, or JSON list object entries with `name` and `path`.
44	    #[arg(long = "lora-modules", value_parser = parse_lora_modules_arg)]
45	    lora_modules: Vec<LoraModule>,
46	
47	    /// Maximum number of resident LoRA adapters in Qwen3 LoRA mode.
48	    #[arg(long = "max-loras", default_value_t = Qwen3LoraOptions::DEFAULT_MAX_LORAS)]
49	    max_loras: usize,
50	
51	    /// Maximum supported LoRA rank in Qwen3 LoRA mode.
52	    #[arg(long = "max-lora-rank", default_value_t = Qwen3LoraOptions::DEFAULT_MAX_LORA_RANK, value_parser = parse_max_lora_rank_arg)]
53	    max_lora_rank: usize,
54	
55	    /// P/D prefill role: barrier each request's KV saves (host tier +
56	    /// MetaServer registration) before its final token event, so this
57	    /// instance's HTTP response doubles as the KV-ready signal a router can
58	    /// act on. Leave off on decode instances.
59	    #[arg(long, default_value_t = false)]
60	    kv_p2p_flush_on_finish: bool,
61	
62	    /// P/D decode role with a vLLM prefill peer: the shared PYTHONHASHSEED
63	    /// value set on every vLLM prefill process. Switches offload query keys to
64	    /// vLLM's prefix-cache hash scheme (requires the P side to run
65	    /// --prefix-caching-hash-algo xxhash_cbor) and makes a cold request wait
66	    /// out the producer's registration tail instead of prefilling locally.
67	    /// Requires --kv-pd-vllm-namespace and the P2P mesh flags.
68	    #[arg(long, value_parser = parse_pythonhashseed)]
69	    kv_pd_vllm_seed: Option<String>,
70	
71	    /// The vLLM prefill peer's pegaflow-connector namespace (an 8-hex digest
72	    /// the connector logs at startup as `namespace=...`). Both sides must
73	    /// address the same content domain. The digest carries no model identity:
74	    /// pointing a decode node at a different model's namespace (same
75	    /// tokenizer, same geometry class) silently cross-loads foreign KV.
76	    #[arg(long, value_parser = parse_pegaflow_namespace)]
77	    kv_pd_vllm_namespace: Option<String>,
78	
79	    /// Zero-hit wait window for --kv-pd-vllm-seed mode, in milliseconds: how
80	    /// long a cold request keeps re-querying before giving up on the expected
81	    /// remote KV and prefilling locally. Must stay below the executor's 15s
82	    /// remote-fetch deadline (enforced at startup).
83	    #[arg(long, default_value_t = 5000)]
84	    kv_pd_miss_wait_ms: u64,
85	
86	    /// Fraction of total GPU memory the Qwen3 instance may use. The KV cache is
87	    /// sized from this budget after startup profiling accounts for weights,
88	    /// runtime buffers, activation peak, margin, and (single-GPU only) CUDA-graph
89	    /// capture; tensor parallelism runs decode eagerly (no graph).
90	    #[arg(long, default_value_t = crate::DEFAULT_GPU_MEMORY_UTILIZATION)]
91	    gpu_memory_utilization: f64,
92	
93	    /// Additional Qwen3 GPU memory to hold back after profile-based KV sizing,
94	    /// in MiB. Covers allocator fragmentation and small unprofiled drift.
95	    #[arg(long, default_value_t = (crate::DEFAULT_KV_CACHE_MEMORY_MARGIN_BYTES >> 20) as usize)]
96	    kv_cache_memory_margin_mib: usize,
97	
98	    /// KV cache page (block) size in tokens. FlashInfer's paged attention only
99	    /// accepts a restricted set; 16 (default) or 64. Larger pages cut block
100	    /// bookkeeping overhead at the cost of coarser-grained allocation.
101	    #[arg(long, default_value_t = crate::DEFAULT_KV_PAGE_SIZE)]
102	    kv_page_size: usize,
103	
104	    /// Enable single-GPU Qwen3 batch-invariant serving by pinning the numeric paths and cutting
105	    /// each prompt's prefill chunks on its own grid. Off by default. Requires `--no-prefix-cache`;
106	    /// incompatible with `--kv-offload`, which keeps prefix matching on regardless.
107	    #[arg(long, default_value_t = false)]
108	    batch_invariant: bool,
109	
110	    /// EAGLE-3 drafter model path. A greedy request drafts while it is the only
111	    /// active request; larger batches decode plainly. Single-GPU only, not with
112	    /// --dflash-draft-model-path, --enable-lora, --kv-offload, --decode-overlap
113	    /// or --batch-invariant, and forces the prefix cache off.
114	    #[arg(long)]
115	    eagle3_draft_model_path: Option<PathBuf>,
116	}
117	
118	fn resolve_decode_overlap(overlap: CliDecodeOverlap, decode_sm_pct: u32) -> DecodeOverlap {
119	    match overlap {
120	        CliDecodeOverlap::Off => DecodeOverlap::Off,
121	        CliDecodeOverlap::Stream => DecodeOverlap::SharedSm,
122	        CliDecodeOverlap::GreenCtx => DecodeOverlap::GreenCtx {
123	            decode_pct: decode_sm_pct,
124	        },
125	    }
126	}
127	
128	fn cli(ctx: &LaunchContext<'_>) -> Qwen3Cli {
129	    Qwen3Cli::from_arg_matches(ctx.matches).expect("Qwen3Cli parses from the merged command")
130	}
131	
132	impl ModelLine for Qwen3Line {
133	    fn name(&self) -> &'static str {
134	        "Qwen3"
135	    }
136	
137	    fn probe(&self, config: &serde_json::Value) -> Result<(), String> {
138	        let model_type = config.get("model_type").and_then(serde_json::Value::as_str);
139	        if model_type != Some("qwen3") {
140	            return Err(format!("model_type {model_type:?} is not \"qwen3\""));
141	        }
142	        crate::probe_config_json(config).map_err(|error| error.to_string())
143	    }
144	
145	    fn augment_cli(&self, cmd: clap::Command) -> clap::Command {
146	        Qwen3Cli::augment_args(cmd)
147	    }
148	
149	    fn consumed_shared_args(&self) -> &'static [&'static str] {
150	        &[
151	            "cuda_graph",
152	            "dump_graph_png",
153	            "device_ordinal",
154	            "tp_size",
155	            "kv_offload",
156	            "kv_offload_host_gib",
157	            "kv_offload_hugepages",
158	            "kv_p2p_metaserver_addr",
159	            "kv_p2p_advertise_addr",
160	            "kv_p2p_nics",
161	            "no_prefix_cache",
162	            "max_prefill_tokens",
163	            "dflash_draft_model_path",
164	            "decode_overlap",
165	            "decode_sm_pct",
166	        ]
167	    }
168	
169	    fn arg_requirements(&self) -> &'static [ArgRequirement] {
170	        &[
171	            ("kv_p2p_flush_on_finish", &["kv_p2p_metaserver_addr"]),
172	            (
173	                "kv_pd_vllm_seed",
174	                &["kv_p2p_metaserver_addr", "kv_pd_vllm_namespace"],
175	            ),
176	            ("kv_pd_vllm_namespace", &["kv_pd_vllm_seed"]),
177	            ("kv_pd_miss_wait_ms", &["kv_pd_vllm_seed"]),
178	        ]
179	    }

1	//! The prompt's history boundary for the OpenAI chat route.
2	//!
3	//! A chat prompt is the rendered conversation followed by the template's
4	//! generation prompt (`<|im_start|>assistant\n<think>\n` for Qwen3.8). The next
5	//! turn of the same conversation repeats the rendered conversation byte for
6	//! byte and then renders the reply the model gave *as history*, which is not
7	//! how the generation prompt reads. So the longest prefix two turns share ends
8	//! where the last message ends, and a scheduler whose state cannot roll back
9	//! (a recurrent line) serves the next turn only from a snapshot taken there.
10	//! Nothing behind the vendored chat route sees the request text, so this layer
11	//! measures the boundary in front of the route and the bridge carries it to
12	//! the scheduler as [`crate::engine::Request::history_tokens`].
13	//!
14	//! The measure is per request and local to the last message: the message is
15	//! rendered alone, with and without the generation prompt, through the same
16	//! renderer and tokenizer the route uses, and the generation prompt's token
17	//! count `T` is the tail the two tokenizations do not share. A token that
18	//! straddles the boundary counts towards `T`, so the boundary moves one token
19	//! earlier rather than into the generation prompt. `T` travels as
20	//! `vllm_xargs.generation_prompt_tokens`; the bridge, which sees the whole
21	//! prompt's token ids, sets `history_tokens = prompt_len - T`. Rendering only
22	//! the last message is exact for a template that appends the generation prompt
23	//! after the messages, which is every template the frontend serves, and costs
24	//! one message's rendering instead of the conversation's.
25	//!
26	//! `add_generation_prompt=false` and `continue_final_message=true` render no
27	//! generation prompt, so `T = 0` and the whole prompt is history. A body the
28	//! measure cannot read (not JSON, no messages, a last message the renderer
29	//! rejects) passes through untouched and the scheduler sees no boundary; the
30	//! route reports its own error for it.
31	//!
32	//! The conversation's earlier turns ended at boundaries of their own, each
33	//! the `history_tokens` of the request that carried it, and a scheduler that
34	//! keeps snapshots beyond the instance that made them (a pooled tier) can
35	//! serve the turn from any of them. Those are measured here too, as
36	//! `vllm_xargs.history_marks`, newest first: every message followed by an
37	//! assistant message ended some earlier request, and the conversation up to
38	//! it, rendered without a generation prompt, tokenizes to that request's
39	//! history. The newest [`MARKS`] are measured, each a rendering of the
40	//! conversation up to it, so a long agent trace pays for a few renderings
41	//! rather than one per turn. A template that tokenizes a boundary
42	//! differently in a longer conversation yields a mark no snapshot sits at,
43	//! which costs a miss and nothing else.
44

46	
47	use axum::Router;
48	use axum::body::Body;
49	use axum::body::Bytes;
50	use axum::body::to_bytes;
51	use axum::extract::Request;
52	use axum::extract::State;

1	//! The prompt's history boundary for the OpenAI chat route.
2	//!
3	//! A chat prompt is the rendered conversation followed by the template's
4	//! generation prompt (`<|im_start|>assistant\n<think>\n` for Qwen3.8). The next
5	//! turn of the same conversation repeats the rendered conversation byte for
6	//! byte and then renders the reply the model gave *as history*, which is not
7	//! how the generation prompt reads. So the longest prefix two turns share ends
8	//! where the last message ends, and a scheduler whose state cannot roll back
9	//! (a recurrent line) serves the next turn only from a snapshot taken there.
10	//! Nothing behind the vendored chat route sees the request text, so this layer
11	//! measures the boundary in front of the route and the bridge carries it to
12	//! the scheduler as [`crate::engine::Request::history_tokens`].
13	//!
14	//! The measure is per request and local to the last message: the message is
15	//! rendered alone, with and without the generation prompt, through the same
16	//! renderer and tokenizer the route uses, and the generation prompt's token
17	//! count `T` is the tail the two tokenizations do not share. A token that
18	//! straddles the boundary counts towards `T`, so the boundary moves one token
19	//! earlier rather than into the generation prompt. `T` travels as
20	//! `vllm_xargs.generation_prompt_tokens`; the bridge, which sees the whole
21	//! prompt's token ids, sets `history_tokens = prompt_len - T`. Rendering only
22	//! the last message is exact for a template that appends the generation prompt
23	//! after the messages, which is every template the frontend serves, and costs
24	//! one message's rendering instead of the conversation's.
25	//!
26	//! `add_generation_prompt=false` and `continue_final_message=true` render no
27	//! generation prompt, so `T = 0` and the whole prompt is history. A body the
28	//! measure cannot read (not JSON, no messages, a last message the renderer
29	//! rejects) passes through untouched and the scheduler sees no boundary; the
30	//! route reports its own error for it.
31	//!
32	//! The conversation's earlier turns ended at boundaries of their own, each
33	//! the `history_tokens` of the request that carried it, and a scheduler that
34	//! keeps snapshots beyond the instance that made them (a pooled tier) can
35	//! serve the turn from any of them. Those are measured here too, as
36	//! `vllm_xargs.history_marks`, newest first: every message followed by an
37	//! assistant message ended some earlier request, and the conversation up to
38	//! it, rendered without a generation prompt, tokenizes to that request's
39	//! history. The newest [`MARKS`] are measured, each a rendering of the
40	//! conversation up to it, so a long agent trace pays for a few renderings
41	//! rather than one per turn. A template that tokenizes a boundary
42	//! differently in a longer conversation yields a mark no snapshot sits at,
43	//! which costs a miss and nothing else.

6	/// A request's KV-prefix resolution, produced by the KV store *before* the
7	/// request reaches a scheduler: how many leading prompt tokens are already
8	/// materialized in the target rank's GPU prefix cache, plus an opaque RAII
9	/// hold keeping those blocks resident until the scheduler's prefix match
10	/// consumes them.
11	///
12	/// The engine contract deliberately does not know KV internals (this crate is
13	/// CUDA-free): the hold is minted by `pegainfer-kv-store`, carried opaquely,
14	/// and only ever *dropped* — after the scheduler's `match_and_add_prefix`, or
15	/// with the request if it dies first. Dropping releases the anti-eviction pin.
16	///
17	/// Degraded resolutions (timeout, pool pressure) are not a distinct state:
18	/// they surface as a smaller `hit_tokens` — the number alone carries all
19	/// downstream semantics (disaggregated-decode admission asserts it against
20	/// the handoff's committed length; everyone else just prefills from
21	/// `hit_tokens`).
22	pub struct KvPrefix {
23	    hit_tokens: usize,
24	    hold: Option<Box<dyn Any + Send>>,
25	    /// The scheduler partition the resolution ran against. The hold pins
26	    /// blocks on THIS rank, so routing anywhere else silently loses the hit
27	    /// and wastes the pin — [`crate::engine::EngineHandle::submit_resolved`]
28	    /// routes by it.
29	    rank: Option<usize>,
30	}
31	
32	impl KvPrefix {
33	    /// No resolution ran (or it degraded to nothing): prefill from scratch.
34	    /// The scheduler's own GPU prefix match still applies as usual.
35	    #[must_use]
36	    pub fn none() -> Self {
37	        Self {
38	            hit_tokens: 0,
39	            hold: None,
40	            rank: None,
41	        }
42	    }
43	
44	    /// A resolved prefix: `hit_tokens` are materialized on partition `rank`,
45	    /// pinned by `hold` until this value is dropped.
46	    #[must_use]
47	    pub fn resolved(hit_tokens: usize, rank: usize, hold: Box<dyn Any + Send>) -> Self {
48	        Self {
49	            hit_tokens,
50	            hold: Some(hold),
51	            rank: Some(rank),
52	        }
53	    }
54	
55	    pub fn hit_tokens(&self) -> usize {
56	        self.hit_tokens
57	    }
58	
59	    /// The partition the resolution is bound to, if one ran.
60	    pub(crate) fn rank(&self) -> Option<usize> {
61	        self.rank
62	    }
63	
64	    /// Whether a hold is still pinning resolved blocks.
65	    pub fn has_hold(&self) -> bool {
66	        self.hold.is_some()
67	    }
68	
69	    /// The opaque hold, for the store that minted it to downcast. Every
70	    /// other crate treats the hold as drop-only.

2	pub struct SamplingParams {
3	    pub temperature: f32,
4	    pub top_k: i32,
5	    pub top_p: f32,
6	    /// Minimum probability threshold relative to the most likely token:
7	    /// tokens with `p < min_p * p_max` are masked. `0.0` disables (the
8	    /// default); valid range is [0, 1).
9	    pub min_p: f32,
10	    /// Per-request sampling seed, handed to the engine as the request gave
11	    /// it. What a seed replays is the engine's promise: a fixed seed gives
12	    /// the same tokens for the same request where the engine's draw depends
13	    /// on nothing else, or at the same batch layout where it does.
14	    pub seed: Option<u64>,
15	    pub ignore_eos: bool,
16	}
17	
18	impl Default for SamplingParams {
19	    fn default() -> Self {
20	        Self {
21	            temperature: 0.0,
22	            top_k: -1,
23	            top_p: 1.0,
24	            min_p: 0.0,
25	            seed: None,
26	            ignore_eos: false,
27	        }
28	    }
29	}
30	
31	impl SamplingParams {
32	    /// Greedy means argmax: temperature below the sampling epsilon (the
33	    /// temperature -> 0 limit is argmax regardless of top_p, and 1/temperature
34	    /// overflows long before that; vLLM draws the same line at 1e-5) or
35	    /// top_k == 1 (a single token survives the mask). Everything else requires
36	    /// a real sampling pass.
37	    pub fn is_greedy(&self) -> bool {
38	        self.temperature < 1e-5 || self.top_k == 1
39	    }
40	}

input.rationale: pegainfer-server 本身是一个约 300 行的纯分发二进制，它的全部实质在它驱动的 pegainfer-frontend 契约（model_line 与 engine 模块）里，因此大纲以 server 为锚点、沿真实依赖深入 frontend：第一单元从零跑起二进制并走通 main 流程与检测门；第二单元拆解 ModelLine trait、SharedArgs、注册表与 ServePlan 这条 CLI 装配链；第三单元进入引擎契约，按"两代契约地图→线类型→账本→驱动循环→接线与路由"递进，全部可用无 GPU 的单元测试和 echo-server 实践；第四单元升到 vLLM 协议栈，覆盖 serve 函数族、HTTP 装配、两代引擎桥、请求整形与特殊路由、可观测性；第五单元以 KV/生命周期细节、接入新模型线的完整清单和设计取舍复盘收尾。source_files 一律相对 pegainfer-server/ 目录书写（crate 外文件以 ../ 开头），与永久链接 base 一致；讲义间依赖构成 DAG，实践任务尽量不依赖 GPU 与真实权重。

描述 pegainfer-server 在工作区中的职责：检测模型、校验 CLI、启动所选引擎，不做任何模型逻辑
对照 README 的架构边界表，指出 server / frontend / 模型 crate / core+kernels / KV 基础设施五层各自负责什么
lectures.practice_task: 阅读 README 与 Cargo.toml 的 [features] 表，画一张 feature 名到模型 crate 的映射表；运行 cargo run --release -- --help（或细读 --help 输出），标注当前默认构建编译进了哪条模型线（qwen3）、哪些线被编译掉，并用 main.rs 里 families() 的 compiled 字段核对结论。
lectures.title: 项目定位与架构地图：pegainfer-server 是什么
lectures.topic: PegaInfer 是纯 Rust + CUDA 的 LLM 推理引擎，pegainfer-server 是它的服务器二进制，只做「检测模型 + 校验 CLI + 启动引擎 + 分发服务」，本讲建立全局地图。

learning_goals: 解释 feature 如何决定二进制内容：default = qwen3，其余模型线经 --features 拉入对应 crate
说明为什么 GPU 构建必须 --release、为什么非 msvc 平台用 jemallocator 做全局分配器
会用 cargo tree 与 --version 验证自己的 feature 构建假设
lectures.practice_task: 执行 cargo tree -p pegainfer-server -e features | head -50 记录默认 feature 集，再对比加 --features gemma4 后依赖图的变化并解释 optional dependency 如何被激活；运行 cargo run --release -- --version，确认二进制名 pegainfer 与版本号 0.1.1 来自 Cargo.toml 的哪些字段。
lectures.title: 构建与运行：feature 矩阵、--release 与全局分配器
lectures.topic: feature 矩阵决定二进制里有哪些模型线：default=qwen3（无 Python），其余按 --features 拉入；GPU 构建必须 --release；非 msvc 使用 jemallocator。

learning_goals: 按顺序说出 main() 的各阶段：ModelLineRegistry::new → build_command → 读 config.json → detect → validate_provided → shared.validate → line.validate → serve_plan → launch → serve
指出引擎加载为何放在 tokio::task::spawn_blocking（与 HTTP 前端并行）以及 LoRA 路径为何例外地串行

learning_goals: 区分三类 flag：CORE_ARGS（所有线可用）、SharedArgs 中按线消费的子集、各线独占 flag
读懂 SHARED_ARG_REQUIREMENTS 与 SharedArgs::validate 分别在哪个阶段生效（clap requires_all vs 显式 validate）
理解 provided_args 如何借助 ValueSource 区分「用户显式提供」与「默认值填充」
lectures.practice_task: 整理一张 SharedArgs 字段表（字段名 / CLI 拼写 / 默认值 / Qwen3Line 是否消费，consumed_shared_args 可查）；实际运行二进制触发两条规则错误：--decode-sm-pct 50（未开 green-ctx，来自 SharedArgs::validate）与 --kv-offload-host-gib 8（未给 --kv-offload，来自 clap requires_all），并说明两条错误为何措辞来源不同。
lectures.title: SharedArgs：跨模型线共享的参数面
lectures.topic: SharedArgs 定义所有线共有的 CLI 面，每条线用 consumed_shared_args 声明自己读哪个子集；跨 flag 规则一部分在 clap requires_all、一部分在 validate() 里手写。

learning_goals: 解释 RegistryClaims 对 flag id 与 CLI 拼写（含长/短 alias）做唯一性断言、为什么 release 构建也要自己验（clap 的 schema 断言在 release 被禁用）
走查 detect 的收集逻辑：rejections 列表如何拼进 NoMatch 错误、Conflict 如何点名两条线
理解 consume-or-reject：每个显式提供的 flag 必须是核心、被消费的共享、或本线独占之一
lectures.practice_task: 在 pegainfer-frontend 的测试模块里（或复制 model_line.rs 测试中的 StubLine 模式到草稿测试）构造两条声明同一 --flag 拼写的 StubLine，确认 ModelLineRegistry::new 按预期 panic；再用公开的 parse_for_line 帮手验证「给 A 线传 B 线独占 flag」会得到 UnconsumedFlag 错误，并写出错误消息原文。
lectures.title: ModelLineRegistry：注册表与 CLI 归属自检
lectures.topic: 注册表在构造时对全部 flag 做 id 与拼写的唯一性检查（冲突即 panic），detect 要求恰好一条线认领配置，validate_provided 做 consume-or-reject。

learning_goals: 列出 Qwen3Line 的独占 flag 分组：LoRA（enable-lora/lora-modules/max-loras/max-lora-rank）、KV P2P、显存预算、batch-invariant、eagle3
读懂 validate() 的冲突矩阵写法：以 provided 集合 + cli 布尔值交叉判断并返回 CliError::rule
跟踪 launch 如何把 SharedArgs 与 Qwen3Cli 折叠成 Qwen3LaunchOptions 并调用 crate::launch
lectures.practice_task: 从 validate() 抄录 --eagle3-draft-model-path 与 --batch-invariant 各自的完整冲突表并画成二维表；准备一个只含真实 Qwen3 config.json（无权重）的模型目录，运行 --model-path <dir> --batch-invariant，确认在引擎加载之前就被「requires --no-prefix-cache」拒绝，再补上 --no-prefix-cache 观察错误推进到哪一步（应到权重加载），以证明校验先于 launch。
lectures.title: 一条真实模型线：Qwen3Line 的独占 CLI 与校验矩阵
lectures.topic: 以 Qwen3Line 为例看完整实现：独占 CLI（LoRA、batch-invariant、eagle3、KV P2P…）、validate 里的冲突矩阵、launch 把 SharedArgs+Qwen3Cli 折成 Qwen3LaunchOptions。

learning_goals: 说出 ServePlan 四个字段各自的消费点：scheduler_partition_count、prefill_only、lora_modules、auto_tool_call_parser
解释 partition 数为何必须在引擎加载前可知：HTTP 前端在引擎仍加载时就要按分区注册 engine identity，并在加载后与实际分区数对账
理解 resolve_tool_call_parser 的优先级：显式用户选择 > 线自带默认 > Auto
lectures.practice_task: 对照 main.rs 写出 plan 每个字段到具体行为的映射表（lora_modules 非空→serve_model_with_lora_routes；prefill_only→serve_prefill_only_with_engine_count；scheduler_partition_count→engine_count 参数）；用一段文字回答：如果把 partition 数推迟到引擎加载后才告知，vllm/mod.rs 里哪段代码会失去依据（提示：TransportMode::Bootstrapped 的 engine_count 与加载完成后的分区数校验）。
lectures.title: ServePlan：引擎加载前就必须知道的服务形态
lectures.topic: ServePlan 把「前端在引擎加载完成前就需要知道的事实」从模型线带出来：分区数、prefill-only、LoRA 模块、auto 工具解析器，main.rs 按它选 serve 分支。

lectures.title: 单元二 · 进阶：ModelLine 契约与 CLI 装配

learning_goals: 画出 engine 模块的两代分组：step 驱动（step/ledger/request_lifecycle/metrics/wiring/driver/control）与 legacy（request/event/sink/kv/handle）
解释 LaunchedEngine::Handle 与 ::Stepped 的区别及 main.rs LoRA 分支为何要求 Stepped
说明 mod.rs 「扁平 re-export」约定：pegainfer_frontend::engine::X 路径不因内部分拆而变
lectures.practice_task: 按 mod.rs 的文档注释画模块依赖图并标注每个模块的生产者/消费者角色；在工作区 grep 统计 LaunchedEngine::Handle 与 LaunchedEngine::Stepped 的出现点（含 From 实现与 serve 装配处），据此写一句话总结当前迁移状态：哪些路径还依赖 legacy 契约。
lectures.title: 引擎契约总览：两代契约并存的地图
lectures.topic: engine 模块的地图：新一代 step 驱动契约（step/ledger/request_lifecycle/metrics/wiring/driver/control）与迁移中的 legacy 每 token 契约（request/event/sink/kv/handle），LaunchedEngine 二选一。

learning_goals: 说出 GenerateRequest 各字段职责：data_parallel_rank 的路由含义、token_tx 的事件出口、trace_parent 的链路上下文
区分 TokenEvent 六种事件（Scheduled/Token/PromptTokens/KvTransfer/Finished/Error/Rejected 中常用的六种）与 FinishReason
解释共享打标通道设计：TokenSink 把事件打上 RequestTag 推进单一 channel，abort reason 用原子状态替代「drop 接收端」
lectures.practice_task: 仿照 handle.rs 测试里的 routed_request 辅助，写一个小测试（可放草稿 crate，依赖 pegainfer-frontend）：用 TokenSink::standalone 构造请求通道，按 Scheduled → Token → Finished 顺序手动 send 三个事件并断言接收顺序；再验证 SamplingParams::is_greedy 在 temperature=0 与 top_k=1 两种参数下都返回 true。
lectures.title: legacy 契约线类型：GenerateRequest、TokenEvent 与 TokenSink
lectures.topic: 旧契约的请求/事件类型：GenerateRequest 的字段、TokenEvent 的事件族、TokenSink 的共享打标通道与 abort reason 机制。

learning_goals: 解释 RequestId 为何是 Copy 整数（进程内路由 id，外部字符串 id 留在协议栈）
说出 Request 上 history_tokens 与 history_marks（新者在前）的多轮会话含义
论证 RequestUpdate 的扁平结构如何把旧协议「Scheduled 先于 token、terminal 恰一次」的约定变成类型本身
lectures.practice_task: 手写一个 fold 函数消费 Vec<RequestUpdate>：按字段顺序处理 admission 事实 → 新 token → terminal，配两三个手工构造样例写成单元测试；再用一段文字回答：为什么「terminal 之后再出 token」在这个类型上不可表达，而旧 TokenEvent 协议只能靠约定保证。
lectures.title: step 契约线类型：StepOutputs 与扁平 RequestUpdate
lectures.topic: 新契约的线类型：RequestId、Request（history_tokens/history_marks）、StepOutputs，以及把「一步内发生的一切」压成一条扁平 RequestUpdate 的设计。

learning_goals: 走查账户生命周期：register 开户（Queued）→ admit 转 Active → push_tokens 计数 → finish/fail/reject/retire/defer_finish 关户
解释 terminal-exactly-once 的强制方式：触碰已关闭或未知账户直接 panic 在出错调用点
区分 pub 与 pub(crate) 的职责划分：register/commit_step/fail_all 只有 driver 能碰，节奏由 driver 拥有
lectures.practice_task: 在 pegainfer-frontend crate 的测试模块里（参考 driver.rs::tests 的 EchoScheduler 写法，或直接运行 cargo test -p pegainfer-frontend --lib engine 检查既有用例）编写一个两步调度测试：第一步 admit + push_tokens，第二步再 push_tokens + finish，断言步流上恰好两条 RequestUpdate 且 token 计数来自账本而非模型侧；复述「对已关账户再 finish 会 panic」由哪行代码保证。
lectures.title: RequestLedger：活请求的账本与 terminal 恰一次
lectures.topic: 账本为每个未答复请求开户：register/admit/push_tokens/finish/fail/reject/retire，commit_step 每迭代出一次账单，terminal 恰一次由「碰已关账户即 panic」强制。

learning_goals: 说出 Scheduler 三个方法的分工：submit 只做所有权转移、step 是唯一裁决点、metrics 供每迭代发布
走查 drive 循环的顺序保证：先排空提交、再 step、再发布 metrics、再 commit 一次
解释致命错误路径：step 返回 Err → 账本 fail_all 写销全部未答复请求 → 线程退出
lectures.practice_task: 在 frontend 测试模块里把 driver.rs::tests 的 EchoScheduler 改成每步 push 两个 token 的变体，断言同样 max_tokens 下 finish 提前一半步数到达；再借助 spawn_scheduler + SchedulerHandle::submit 跑一次完整回路：提交一个请求、从 take_steps() 取出的接收端读到 Scheduled 与 terminal（参考 echo-server.rs 的用法）。
lectures.title: Scheduler trait 与 drive 轮询循环
lectures.topic: Scheduler 只有三方法（submit/step/metrics），drive 循环把排空顺序、每迭代一次 metrics 发布一次 commit、致命写销、空闲自旋统一成一份代码而非各 crate 纪律。

learning_goals: 解释 scheduler_pair 两侧的通道选型：提交用 crossbeam（同步消费者）、步流用 tokio mpsc（异步消费者）、metrics 用共享单元
说出 Engine/EngineInfo/LaunchedEngine 的装配关系与 EngineInfo 两个 Option 字段的显式语义
推导 legacy EngineHandle 的路由：绑定 rank 优先、无绑定走 running + 4×waiting 最低分、越界 rank 以 Scheduled→Rejected 应答而非丢请求
lectures.practice_task: 复现 handle.rs 的 least-loaded 测试思路于草稿测试：用 EngineHandle::new_with_join_handles 造三个分区并挂不同 SchedulerMetrics 的 watch，提交无绑定请求断言落在分数最低（running+4×waiting）的分区；再用 KvPrefix 的 rank 语义解释 submit_resolved 里「已解析前缀绑定 rank、与调用方绑定不一致视为调用方 bug」的 debug_assert。
lectures.title: 接线与路由：scheduler_pair、Engine 与 legacy EngineHandle
lectures.topic: scheduler_pair 一次铸出双端接线；Engine/EngineInfo 是 step 引擎的交接包；legacy EngineHandle 按绑定 rank 或最低负载（running+4×waiting）做多分区路由。

lectures.title: 单元三 · 进阶：引擎契约与请求生命周期

learning_goals: 列出 serve 函数族并说明 main.rs 选中每条的条件（普通、prefill-only、LoRA）
解释 serve_model_on_host_with_router_extension 的装配：预绑定 unix socket fd、bridges JoinSet、引擎失败时 server_shutdown 取消
说出引擎计数对账与 30 分钟 ready_timeout 的用意
minimal_modules: 引擎任务与 shutdown 级联
lectures.practice_task: 从 main.rs 的非 LoRA 分支出发画两条并行时间线：spawn_blocking 的引擎加载与 vllm-server 的 tokenizer/模板加载，标出二者在哪个 await 点汇合、HTTP 端口何时才算「可达即就绪」；再写出引擎加载失败时的完整取消链（engine 任务 → server_shutdown.cancel → 错误向上传播）。
lectures.title: serve 函数族：并发加载与装配骨架
lectures.topic: vllm::serve / serve_with_engine_count / serve_prefill_only_with_engine_count / serve_model_with_lora_routes 的共同骨架：预绑定 unix socket、HTTP 前端与引擎加载并发、分区数对账、shutdown 级联。

learning_goals: 逐项说出 Config 中与本教程相关的关键字段：TransportMode::Bootstrapped、ListenerMode::BindTcp、tool_call_parser、stream_interval、disable_log_stats
解释 load_model_backends 失败时仅告警降级（chat 请求整形关闭）的原因
描述路由扩展链的包裹顺序：最外层 normalize_chat_requests，内层 mark_history，最里层 extend_router
lectures.practice_task: 运行 cargo run -p pegainfer-frontend --example echo-server（无 GPU），按其文件头注释的 curl 分别打 /v1/completions 与流式 /v1/chat/completions；整理一段「CLI flag → SharedArgs 字段 → Config 字段」的映射笔记（至少覆盖 --port 与 --tool-call-parser 两条链），并指出 echo 请求的 completion 文本为什么等于 prompt。
lectures.title: HTTP 前端装配：Config 逐项与路由扩展链
lectures.topic: serve_model_on_host_with_router_extension 里那个巨大的 vllm_server::Config 逐项精读，以及 router 扩展链（mark_history → normalize_chat_requests → 用户扩展）的包裹顺序。

learning_goals: 解释 zmq dealer/push 双 socket 与预绑定 listener fd 的对接方式（Bootstrapped transport）
对比两代桥：legacy 把每 token 事件流再折叠成 burst 输出，stepped 把 StepOutputs 1:1 翻译成 EngineCoreOutputs
说出 stepped 桥如何把契约的单调 Instant 渲染成线上墙钟时间（每桥一个锚点）
lectures.practice_task: 跟踪一个 token 的完整旅程并画成时序图：HTTP body → EngineCoreRequest → 桥 → SchedulerHandle::submit → 调度器 step → RequestUpdate.tokens → EngineCoreOutputs → SSE chunk；在图上并排画 legacy 与 stepped 两代桥，标注它们在「每 token 唤醒次数」与「批处理折叠位置」上的差异。
lectures.title: 两代引擎桥：LocalEngineBridge 与 SteppedEngineBridge
lectures.topic: 引擎桥把引擎接到 vLLM EngineCore 协议（zmq）：legacy 桥把共享打标事件流 demux 并折叠成 burst 输出；stepped 桥把每个 StepOutputs 消息 1:1 翻译成 EngineCoreOutputs。

learning_goals: 复述边界测量算法：单独渲染最后一条消息、比较带/不带 generation prompt 的 tokenization 差 T，桥侧置 history_tokens = prompt_len - T
解释 history_marks（新者在前）如何让保留多快照的调度器从更早边界恢复下一轮
说明为什么 effort 规范化要放在最外层（边界测量要读到路由真正渲染用的值）
lectures.practice_task: 给 echo-server 发两轮对话（第二轮带上第一轮的 assistant 回复），依据 history.rs 的算法手工推算第二轮请求的 history_tokens 与 history_marks 序列，并对照 step.rs::Request 的字段注释核验；再用一段话解释 add_generation_prompt=false 与 continue_final_message=true 时 T=0、整个 prompt 都是 history 的含义。
lectures.title: 请求整形：history 边界测量与 reasoning effort 规范化
lectures.topic: 两个 axum 中间层：history.rs 测量会话边界（generation prompt 尾长 T、history_tokens、history_marks），reasoning_effort.rs 做 effort 别名规范化；测量结果经 vllm_xargs 与桥进入 Request。

learning_goals: 走查 prefill-only 门：读 body → 判 max_tokens/max_completion_tokens 恰为 1 → 改写 Content-Length 转发内层路由，否则 400
解释 LoraClient 的 Option 即能力：未铸造控制通道的引擎无法服务 LoRA 路由（serve_model_with_lora_routes 显式报错）
复述 main.rs LoRA 分支为何串行：路由构建期就需要引擎控制平面，且要求 LaunchedEngine::Stepped
lectures.practice_task: 仿照 request_contract.rs 在草稿测试里用 tower::ServiceExt::oneshot 驱动一个挂了 prefill-only 门的 axum Router：对 /v1/completions 分别发 max_tokens=2（期望 400 且错误 JSON 含 invalid_request_error）与 max_tokens=1（期望透传到内层 fallback）；再写出 --enable-lora 从 CLI 到 serve_model_with_lora_routes 的完整触发链。
lectures.title: 特殊服务面：prefill-only 门与 LoRA 路由
lectures.topic: 两个非默认服务面：prefill-only 路由在 axum 层强制 max_tokens=1（否则 400）；LoRA 路由要求引擎铸造 control 通道（LoraClient 是能力本身），启动时装载列出的适配器。

learning_goals: 说出 SchedulerMetrics 各字段含义与两类累计计数器（spec_decode、prefix_cache）的语义
解释发布通道两代差异：stepped 引擎写共享单元（MetricsPublisher），legacy 引擎用 watch 通道，changed() 仅在真实变化时唤醒
论证计数器为何必须是累计值：读者只看到最新快照，无法对每步增量求和
lectures.practice_task: 运行 echo-server 并 curl /metrics，尝试定位 scheduler/stats 相关输出（如找不到，对照代码说明 stepped 桥 stats 从 SchedulerHandle::metrics 而来、由上游 recorder 决定导出名）；写出一条前缀缓存命中数（prefix_cache.hits）从调度器到 /metrics 的传播路径，并解释「计数必须是累计值」在代码里的注释依据。
lectures.title: 可观测性：SchedulerMetrics 从调度器到 /metrics
lectures.topic: SchedulerMetrics 是调度器每迭代发布的自画像（KV 块占用、running/waiting、spec-decode 与 prefix-cache 累计计数），经共享单元或 watch 通道到桥的 stats，最终进入 /metrics。

lectures.title: 单元四 · 高级：vLLM 协议栈与对外服务面

learning_goals: 解释 KvPrefix 的三个成员：hit_tokens（退化解析也只是一 个更小的数）、绑定 rank、drop-only 的不透明 hold
走查 RequestEnvelope 的 drop 炸弹：调度器线程消失后新提交仍能拿到 Failed 终态
区分 RequestControl 的 abort 置位路径与调度器的 retire 响应，以及 DeferredFinish 的迟到终态场景
lectures.practice_task: 对 echo-server 发一个 max_tokens 较大的流式请求并中途 Ctrl-C，对照代码指出：abort reason 在哪一层被置位（TokenSink 的原子状态 / stepped 契约的 ledger is_aborted）、调度器在哪个方法里 retire；再写一段话论证「已解析前缀与调用方绑定 rank 不一致」为什么是调用方 bug 而非引擎故障（提示：hold 把块钉在解析时的 rank 上）。
lectures.title: KV 前缀解析与请求控制细节
lectures.topic: 契约边缘的三块硬骨头：KvPrefix 的不透明 RAII hold 与 rank 绑定、RequestEnvelope 的 drop 炸弹与 RequestControl abort、DeferredFinish 与 StopPolicy 的迟到终态。

learning_goals: 按清单复述接入步骤：实现 ModelLine → 注册进 model_lines() → Cargo feature → families() 行 + 单测 → detect_gate 式端到端测试
解释 echo-server.rs 为何是官方参考：一个不含 GPU 的完整模型线（probe + Scheduler + launch + 镜像 main 的服务流程）
说出 detect_gate.rs 的两用 fixture 设计：冻结 config 来自模型 crate，tokenizer 来自 echo-model，两条路径都不触达 CUDA
minimal_modules: server 注册与 families 行
lectures.practice_task: 把 echo-server.rs 复制改造成 Reverse 线：probe 认领 model_type=reverse，调度器把 prompt 逆序逐 token 吐回（改 EchoScheduler 的出队方向），在 examples 或临时 bin 里跑起来，用 /v1/completions 验证输出顺序；随后在草稿中完成剩余清单——给 families() 加 reverse 行、写 hint 单测、仿 detect_gate.rs 写一个针对该二进制的检测门测试。
lectures.title: 从零接入一条新模型线：完整清单
lectures.topic: 把前四单元串成一个可操作清单：在模型 crate 实现 ModelLine、在 server 注册、加 Cargo feature、补 families() 行与提示测试、写 detect_gate 式端到端测试；echo-server.rs 是全程可跑的参考。

learning_goals: 论证纯分发二进制的收益：server 不 import 任何模型的选项类型，新增模型线对 server 的唯一改动是注册一行
界定 feature_gate_hint 的能力边界：identity-only，无法运行被编译掉的 probe，量化变体/绑词嵌入/YaRN 也会命中提示
给出两代契约合并的判据：所有模型线迁到 step 驱动后 LaunchedEngine 可删，ServePlan::default 的扩展约定（CI 编译三条线）是防漂移手段
lectures.practice_task: 写一页设计笔记回答三问：(1) 若把 SharedArgs 拆进各模型 crate，注册表的哪些自检（id/拼写唯一性、consume-or-reject）会失效或变贵；(2) 一个 model_type=qwen3 的量化变体在 stock 构建下会得到什么提示、这个提示在什么意义上是「过度承诺」，依据 families() 的文档注释作答；(3) 删除 LaunchedEngine::Handle 需要哪些前提，当前 main.rs 与 vllm/mod.rs 里哪些分支会随之消失。
lectures.title: 设计取舍复盘：纯分发二进制与契约迁移
lectures.topic: 复盘三个架构决定：server 只做纯分发的代价与收益、families() 作为「必要的第二真相源」的 identity-only 边界、两代引擎契约共存的迁移边界与删除条件。

lectures.title: 单元五 · 专家：扩展、细节与二次开发

call_830b989c55ed4c038d186116.head: af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509
call_830b989c55ed4c038d186116.rationale: pegainfer-server 本身是一个约 300 行的纯分发二进制，它的全部实质在它驱动的 pegainfer-frontend 契约（model_line 与 engine 模块）里，因此大纲以 server 为锚点、沿真实依赖深入 frontend：第一单元从零跑起二进制并走通 main 流程与检测门；第二单元拆解 ModelLine trait、SharedArgs、注册表与 ServePlan 这条 CLI 装配链；第三单元进入引擎契约，按"两代契约地图→线类型→账本→驱动循环→接线与路由"递进，全部可用无 GPU 的单元测试和 echo-server 实践；第四单元升到 vLLM 协议栈，覆盖 serve 函数族、HTTP 装配、两代引擎桥、请求整形与特殊路由、可观测性；第五单元以 KV/生命周期细节、接入新模型线的完整清单和设计取舍复盘收尾。source_files 一律相对 pegainfer-server/ 目录书写（crate 外文件以 ../ 开头），与永久链接 base 一致；讲义间依赖构成 DAG，实践任务尽量不依赖 GPU 与真实权重。

learning_goals: 说出 PegaInfer 的定位：纯 Rust + CUDA 的 LLM 推理引擎，提供 OpenAI 兼容 /v1 API
描述 pegainfer-server 在工作区中的职责：检测模型、校验 CLI、启动所选引擎，不做任何模型逻辑
对照 README 的架构边界表，指出 server / frontend / 模型 crate / core+kernels / KV 基础设施五层各自负责什么
lectures.practice_task: 阅读 README 与 Cargo.toml 的 [features] 表，画一张 feature 名到模型 crate 的映射表；运行 cargo run --release -- --help（或细读 --help 输出），标注当前默认构建编译进了哪条模型线（qwen3）、哪些线被编译掉，并用 main.rs 里 families() 的 compiled 字段核对结论。
lectures.title: 项目定位与架构地图：pegainfer-server 是什么
lectures.topic: PegaInfer 是纯 Rust + CUDA 的 LLM 推理引擎，pegainfer-server 是它的服务器二进制，只做「检测模型 + 校验 CLI + 启动引擎 + 分发服务」，本讲建立全局地图。

learning_goals: 解释 feature 如何决定二进制内容：default = qwen3，其余模型线经 --features 拉入对应 crate
说明为什么 GPU 构建必须 --release、为什么非 msvc 平台用 jemallocator 做全局分配器
会用 cargo tree 与 --version 验证自己的 feature 构建假设
lectures.practice_task: 执行 cargo tree -p pegainfer-server -e features | head -50 记录默认 feature 集，再对比加 --features gemma4 后依赖图的变化并解释 optional dependency 如何被激活；运行 cargo run --release -- --version，确认二进制名 pegainfer 与版本号 0.1.1 来自 Cargo.toml 的哪些字段。
lectures.title: 构建与运行：feature 矩阵、--release 与全局分配器
lectures.topic: feature 矩阵决定二进制里有哪些模型线：default=qwen3（无 Python），其余按 --features 拉入；GPU 构建必须 --release；非 msvc 使用 jemallocator。

learning_goals: 按顺序说出 main() 的各阶段：ModelLineRegistry::new → build_command → 读 config.json → detect → validate_provided → shared.validate → line.validate → serve_plan → launch → serve
指出引擎加载为何放在 tokio::task::spawn_blocking（与 HTTP 前端并行）以及 LoRA 路径为何例外地串行
定位 tracing::flush 在错误传播前被调用的原因
minimal_modules: 引擎加载与 Ctrl-C 两段式
lectures.practice_task: 给 main() 画一张流程图，标注每一步失败时返回给用户的错误形态；分别用 --port 9000 正常启动到引擎加载、以及 --model-path 指向不存在目录两种方式运行，把日志/错误逐条对应回流程图中的阶段。
lectures.title: main.rs 全景：从 CLI 到 serve 的启动主流程
lectures.topic: 逐段走读 main()：建注册表、合并 CLI、读 config.json、detect、两级 validate、serve_plan、spawn_blocking 加载引擎、三条 serve 分支的选择。

learning_goals: 解释 registry.detect 的三种结果：唯一认领、Conflict（两条线都认领）、NoMatch（带各线拒绝原因）
说明 families() 为什么是「必要的第二真相源」：被编译掉的线的 probe 无法运行，只能硬编码 identity 表
读懂 detect_gate.rs 集成测试如何用冻结 config 与最小 tokenizer 驱动真实二进制断言两种出厂行为
lectures.practice_task: 手工构造目录：config.json 写 {"model_type": "glm_moe_dsa"}，再放一个 tokenizer.json（可复制 pegainfer-frontend/examples/echo-model/tokenizer.json），运行二进制观察输出中的 --features glm52 提示；换 model_type 为 frobnicate_lm 验证未知家族不触发提示；最后对照 tests/detect_gate.rs 说明 stock 与 enabled 两种断言分别验证什么。
lectures.title: 检测门：config.json 判定与 feature 提示
lectures.topic: detect 的判定逻辑，以及当配置属于「存在但被编译掉」的家族时 feature_gate_hint 给出 rebuild 建议；detect_gate 集成测试如何驱动真实二进制验证这道门。

lectures.title: 单元一 · 入门：跑起 pegainfer-server

learning_goals: 逐个说出 ModelLine 的 8 个方法及默认实现（augment_cli、consumed_shared_args、arg_requirements、validate、serve_plan 都可缺省）
解释「接缝」含义：server 二进制只持有 &'static dyn ModelLine，从不 import 任何模型 crate 的选项类型
理解 launch 返回 LaunchedEngine 及其错误为何用 anyhow（深层上下文链，调用方不分支）
lectures.practice_task: 以 ../pegainfer-frontend/examples/echo-server.rs 的 EchoLine 为模板，在草稿工程里实现一个 ReverseLine：name 返回 "Reverse"，probe 认领 model_type=reverse，launch 返回最简 Engine（可先照抄 EchoScheduler）；目标是编译通过并说清哪三个方法是必选、哪些可省。
lectures.title: ModelLine trait：server 与模型 crate 之间的接缝
lectures.topic: ModelLine 是模型线暴露给 server 的全部表面：probe 认领 config、augment_cli 增补独占 flag、launch 启动调度器线程并交回 LaunchedEngine。

learning_goals: 区分三类 flag：CORE_ARGS（所有线可用）、SharedArgs 中按线消费的子集、各线独占 flag
读懂 SHARED_ARG_REQUIREMENTS 与 SharedArgs::validate 分别在哪个阶段生效（clap requires_all vs 显式 validate）
理解 provided_args 如何借助 ValueSource 区分「用户显式提供」与「默认值填充」
lectures.practice_task: 整理一张 SharedArgs 字段表（字段名 / CLI 拼写 / 默认值 / Qwen3Line 是否消费，consumed_shared_args 可查）；实际运行二进制触发两条规则错误：--decode-sm-pct 50（未开 green-ctx，来自 SharedArgs::validate）与 --kv-offload-host-gib 8（未给 --kv-offload，来自 clap requires_all），并说明两条错误为何措辞来源不同。
lectures.title: SharedArgs：跨模型线共享的参数面
lectures.topic: SharedArgs 定义所有线共有的 CLI 面，每条线用 consumed_shared_args 声明自己读哪个子集；跨 flag 规则一部分在 clap requires_all、一部分在 validate() 里手写。

learning_goals: 解释 RegistryClaims 对 flag id 与 CLI 拼写（含长/短 alias）做唯一性断言、为什么 release 构建也要自己验（clap 的 schema 断言在 release 被禁用）
走查 detect 的收集逻辑：rejections 列表如何拼进 NoMatch 错误、Conflict 如何点名两条线
理解 consume-or-reject：每个显式提供的 flag 必须是核心、被消费的共享、或本线独占之一
lectures.practice_task: 在 pegainfer-frontend 的测试模块里（或复制 model_line.rs 测试中的 StubLine 模式到草稿测试）构造两条声明同一 --flag 拼写的 StubLine，确认 ModelLineRegistry::new 按预期 panic；再用公开的 parse_for_line 帮手验证「给 A 线传 B 线独占 flag」会得到 UnconsumedFlag 错误，并写出错误消息原文。
lectures.title: ModelLineRegistry：注册表与 CLI 归属自检
lectures.topic: 注册表在构造时对全部 flag 做 id 与拼写的唯一性检查（冲突即 panic），detect 要求恰好一条线认领配置，validate_provided 做 consume-or-reject。

learning_goals: 列出 Qwen3Line 的独占 flag 分组：LoRA（enable-lora/lora-modules/max-loras/max-lora-rank）、KV P2P、显存预算、batch-invariant、eagle3
读懂 validate() 的冲突矩阵写法：以 provided 集合 + cli 布尔值交叉判断并返回 CliError::rule
跟踪 launch 如何把 SharedArgs 与 Qwen3Cli 折叠成 Qwen3LaunchOptions 并调用 crate::launch
lectures.practice_task: 从 validate() 抄录 --eagle3-draft-model-path 与 --batch-invariant 各自的完整冲突表并画成二维表；准备一个只含真实 Qwen3 config.json（无权重）的模型目录，运行 --model-path <dir> --batch-invariant，确认在引擎加载之前就被「requires --no-prefix-cache」拒绝，再补上 --no-prefix-cache 观察错误推进到哪一步（应到权重加载），以证明校验先于 launch。
lectures.title: 一条真实模型线：Qwen3Line 的独占 CLI 与校验矩阵
lectures.topic: 以 Qwen3Line 为例看完整实现：独占 CLI（LoRA、batch-invariant、eagle3、KV P2P…）、validate 里的冲突矩阵、launch 把 SharedArgs+Qwen3Cli 折成 Qwen3LaunchOptions。

learning_goals: 说出 ServePlan 四个字段各自的消费点：scheduler_partition_count、prefill_only、lora_modules、auto_tool_call_parser
解释 partition 数为何必须在引擎加载前可知：HTTP 前端在引擎仍加载时就要按分区注册 engine identity，并在加载后与实际分区数对账
理解 resolve_tool_call_parser 的优先级：显式用户选择 > 线自带默认 > Auto
lectures.practice_task: 对照 main.rs 写出 plan 每个字段到具体行为的映射表（lora_modules 非空→serve_model_with_lora_routes；prefill_only→serve_prefill_only_with_engine_count；scheduler_partition_count→engine_count 参数）；用一段文字回答：如果把 partition 数推迟到引擎加载后才告知，vllm/mod.rs 里哪段代码会失去依据（提示：TransportMode::Bootstrapped 的 engine_count 与加载完成后的分区数校验）。
lectures.title: ServePlan：引擎加载前就必须知道的服务形态
lectures.topic: ServePlan 把「前端在引擎加载完成前就需要知道的事实」从模型线带出来：分区数、prefill-only、LoRA 模块、auto 工具解析器，main.rs 按它选 serve 分支。

lectures.title: 单元二 · 进阶：ModelLine 契约与 CLI 装配

learning_goals: 画出 engine 模块的两代分组：step 驱动（step/ledger/request_lifecycle/metrics/wiring/driver/control）与 legacy（request/event/sink/kv/handle）
解释 LaunchedEngine::Handle 与 ::Stepped 的区别及 main.rs LoRA 分支为何要求 Stepped
说明 mod.rs 「扁平 re-export」约定：pegainfer_frontend::engine::X 路径不因内部分拆而变
lectures.practice_task: 按 mod.rs 的文档注释画模块依赖图并标注每个模块的生产者/消费者角色；在工作区 grep 统计 LaunchedEngine::Handle 与 LaunchedEngine::Stepped 的出现点（含 From 实现与 serve 装配处），据此写一句话总结当前迁移状态：哪些路径还依赖 legacy 契约。
lectures.title: 引擎契约总览：两代契约并存的地图
lectures.topic: engine 模块的地图：新一代 step 驱动契约（step/ledger/request_lifecycle/metrics/wiring/driver/control）与迁移中的 legacy 每 token 契约（request/event/sink/kv/handle），LaunchedEngine 二选一。

learning_goals: 说出 GenerateRequest 各字段职责：data_parallel_rank 的路由含义、token_tx 的事件出口、trace_parent 的链路上下文
区分 TokenEvent 六种事件（Scheduled/Token/PromptTokens/KvTransfer/Finished/Error/Rejected 中常用的六种）与 FinishReason
解释共享打标通道设计：TokenSink 把事件打上 RequestTag 推进单一 channel，abort reason 用原子状态替代「drop 接收端」
lectures.practice_task: 仿照 handle.rs 测试里的 routed_request 辅助，写一个小测试（可放草稿 crate，依赖 pegainfer-frontend）：用 TokenSink::standalone 构造请求通道，按 Scheduled → Token → Finished 顺序手动 send 三个事件并断言接收顺序；再验证 SamplingParams::is_greedy 在 temperature=0 与 top_k=1 两种参数下都返回 true。
lectures.title: legacy 契约线类型：GenerateRequest、TokenEvent 与 TokenSink
lectures.topic: 旧契约的请求/事件类型：GenerateRequest 的字段、TokenEvent 的事件族、TokenSink 的共享打标通道与 abort reason 机制。

learning_goals: 解释 RequestId 为何是 Copy 整数（进程内路由 id，外部字符串 id 留在协议栈）
说出 Request 上 history_tokens 与 history_marks（新者在前）的多轮会话含义
论证 RequestUpdate 的扁平结构如何把旧协议「Scheduled 先于 token、terminal 恰一次」的约定变成类型本身
lectures.practice_task: 手写一个 fold 函数消费 Vec<RequestUpdate>：按字段顺序处理 admission 事实 → 新 token → terminal，配两三个手工构造样例写成单元测试；再用一段文字回答：为什么「terminal 之后再出 token」在这个类型上不可表达，而旧 TokenEvent 协议只能靠约定保证。
lectures.title: step 契约线类型：StepOutputs 与扁平 RequestUpdate
lectures.topic: 新契约的线类型：RequestId、Request（history_tokens/history_marks）、StepOutputs，以及把「一步内发生的一切」压成一条扁平 RequestUpdate 的设计。

learning_goals: 走查账户生命周期：register 开户（Queued）→ admit 转 Active → push_tokens 计数 → finish/fail/reject/retire/defer_finish 关户
解释 terminal-exactly-once 的强制方式：触碰已关闭或未知账户直接 panic 在出错调用点
区分 pub 与 pub(crate) 的职责划分：register/commit_step/fail_all 只有 driver 能碰，节奏由 driver 拥有
lectures.practice_task: 在 pegainfer-frontend crate 的测试模块里（参考 driver.rs::tests 的 EchoScheduler 写法，或直接运行 cargo test -p pegainfer-frontend --lib engine 检查既有用例）编写一个两步调度测试：第一步 admit + push_tokens，第二步再 push_tokens + finish，断言步流上恰好两条 RequestUpdate 且 token 计数来自账本而非模型侧；复述「对已关账户再 finish 会 panic」由哪行代码保证。
lectures.title: RequestLedger：活请求的账本与 terminal 恰一次
lectures.topic: 账本为每个未答复请求开户：register/admit/push_tokens/finish/fail/reject/retire，commit_step 每迭代出一次账单，terminal 恰一次由「碰已关账户即 panic」强制。

learning_goals: 说出 Scheduler 三个方法的分工：submit 只做所有权转移、step 是唯一裁决点、metrics 供每迭代发布
走查 drive 循环的顺序保证：先排空提交、再 step、再发布 metrics、再 commit 一次
解释致命错误路径：step 返回 Err → 账本 fail_all 写销全部未答复请求 → 线程退出
lectures.practice_task: 在 frontend 测试模块里把 driver.rs::tests 的 EchoScheduler 改成每步 push 两个 token 的变体，断言同样 max_tokens 下 finish 提前一半步数到达；再借助 spawn_scheduler + SchedulerHandle::submit 跑一次完整回路：提交一个请求、从 take_steps() 取出的接收端读到 Scheduled 与 terminal（参考 echo-server.rs 的用法）。
lectures.title: Scheduler trait 与 drive 轮询循环
lectures.topic: Scheduler 只有三方法（submit/step/metrics），drive 循环把排空顺序、每迭代一次 metrics 发布一次 commit、致命写销、空闲自旋统一成一份代码而非各 crate 纪律。

learning_goals: 解释 scheduler_pair 两侧的通道选型：提交用 crossbeam（同步消费者）、步流用 tokio mpsc（异步消费者）、metrics 用共享单元
说出 Engine/EngineInfo/LaunchedEngine 的装配关系与 EngineInfo 两个 Option 字段的显式语义
推导 legacy EngineHandle 的路由：绑定 rank 优先、无绑定走 running + 4×waiting 最低分、越界 rank 以 Scheduled→Rejected 应答而非丢请求
lectures.practice_task: 复现 handle.rs 的 least-loaded 测试思路于草稿测试：用 EngineHandle::new_with_join_handles 造三个分区并挂不同 SchedulerMetrics 的 watch，提交无绑定请求断言落在分数最低（running+4×waiting）的分区；再用 KvPrefix 的 rank 语义解释 submit_resolved 里「已解析前缀绑定 rank、与调用方绑定不一致视为调用方 bug」的 debug_assert。
lectures.title: 接线与路由：scheduler_pair、Engine 与 legacy EngineHandle
lectures.topic: scheduler_pair 一次铸出双端接线；Engine/EngineInfo 是 step 引擎的交接包；legacy EngineHandle 按绑定 rank 或最低负载（running+4×waiting）做多分区路由。

lectures.title: 单元三 · 进阶：引擎契约与请求生命周期

learning_goals: 列出 serve 函数族并说明 main.rs 选中每条的条件（普通、prefill-only、LoRA）
解释 serve_model_on_host_with_router_extension 的装配：预绑定 unix socket fd、bridges JoinSet、引擎失败时 server_shutdown 取消
说出引擎计数对账与 30 分钟 ready_timeout 的用意
minimal_modules: 引擎任务与 shutdown 级联
lectures.practice_task: 从 main.rs 的非 LoRA 分支出发画两条并行时间线：spawn_blocking 的引擎加载与 vllm-server 的 tokenizer/模板加载，标出二者在哪个 await 点汇合、HTTP 端口何时才算「可达即就绪」；再写出引擎加载失败时的完整取消链（engine 任务 → server_shutdown.cancel → 错误向上传播）。
lectures.title: serve 函数族：并发加载与装配骨架
lectures.topic: vllm::serve / serve_with_engine_count / serve_prefill_only_with_engine_count / serve_model_with_lora_routes 的共同骨架：预绑定 unix socket、HTTP 前端与引擎加载并发、分区数对账、shutdown 级联。

learning_goals: 逐项说出 Config 中与本教程相关的关键字段：TransportMode::Bootstrapped、ListenerMode::BindTcp、tool_call_parser、stream_interval、disable_log_stats
解释 load_model_backends 失败时仅告警降级（chat 请求整形关闭）的原因
描述路由扩展链的包裹顺序：最外层 normalize_chat_requests，内层 mark_history，最里层 extend_router
lectures.practice_task: 运行 cargo run -p pegainfer-frontend --example echo-server（无 GPU），按其文件头注释的 curl 分别打 /v1/completions 与流式 /v1/chat/completions；整理一段「CLI flag → SharedArgs 字段 → Config 字段」的映射笔记（至少覆盖 --port 与 --tool-call-parser 两条链），并指出 echo 请求的 completion 文本为什么等于 prompt。
lectures.title: HTTP 前端装配：Config 逐项与路由扩展链
lectures.topic: serve_model_on_host_with_router_extension 里那个巨大的 vllm_server::Config 逐项精读，以及 router 扩展链（mark_history → normalize_chat_requests → 用户扩展）的包裹顺序。

learning_goals: 解释 zmq dealer/push 双 socket 与预绑定 listener fd 的对接方式（Bootstrapped transport）
对比两代桥：legacy 把每 token 事件流再折叠成 burst 输出，stepped 把 StepOutputs 1:1 翻译成 EngineCoreOutputs
说出 stepped 桥如何把契约的单调 Instant 渲染成线上墙钟时间（每桥一个锚点）
lectures.practice_task: 跟踪一个 token 的完整旅程并画成时序图：HTTP body → EngineCoreRequest → 桥 → SchedulerHandle::submit → 调度器 step → RequestUpdate.tokens → EngineCoreOutputs → SSE chunk；在图上并排画 legacy 与 stepped 两代桥，标注它们在「每 token 唤醒次数」与「批处理折叠位置」上的差异。
lectures.title: 两代引擎桥：LocalEngineBridge 与 SteppedEngineBridge
lectures.topic: 引擎桥把引擎接到 vLLM EngineCore 协议（zmq）：legacy 桥把共享打标事件流 demux 并折叠成 burst 输出；stepped 桥把每个 StepOutputs 消息 1:1 翻译成 EngineCoreOutputs。

learning_goals: 复述边界测量算法：单独渲染最后一条消息、比较带/不带 generation prompt 的 tokenization 差 T，桥侧置 history_tokens = prompt_len - T
解释 history_marks（新者在前）如何让保留多快照的调度器从更早边界恢复下一轮
说明为什么 effort 规范化要放在最外层（边界测量要读到路由真正渲染用的值）
lectures.practice_task: 给 echo-server 发两轮对话（第二轮带上第一轮的 assistant 回复），依据 history.rs 的算法手工推算第二轮请求的 history_tokens 与 history_marks 序列，并对照 step.rs::Request 的字段注释核验；再用一段话解释 add_generation_prompt=false 与 continue_final_message=true 时 T=0、整个 prompt 都是 history 的含义。
lectures.title: 请求整形：history 边界测量与 reasoning effort 规范化
lectures.topic: 两个 axum 中间层：history.rs 测量会话边界（generation prompt 尾长 T、history_tokens、history_marks），reasoning_effort.rs 做 effort 别名规范化；测量结果经 vllm_xargs 与桥进入 Request。

learning_goals: 走查 prefill-only 门：读 body → 判 max_tokens/max_completion_tokens 恰为 1 → 改写 Content-Length 转发内层路由，否则 400
解释 LoraClient 的 Option 即能力：未铸造控制通道的引擎无法服务 LoRA 路由（serve_model_with_lora_routes 显式报错）
复述 main.rs LoRA 分支为何串行：路由构建期就需要引擎控制平面，且要求 LaunchedEngine::Stepped
lectures.practice_task: 仿照 request_contract.rs 在草稿测试里用 tower::ServiceExt::oneshot 驱动一个挂了 prefill-only 门的 axum Router：对 /v1/completions 分别发 max_tokens=2（期望 400 且错误 JSON 含 invalid_request_error）与 max_tokens=1（期望透传到内层 fallback）；再写出 --enable-lora 从 CLI 到 serve_model_with_lora_routes 的完整触发链。
lectures.title: 特殊服务面：prefill-only 门与 LoRA 路由
lectures.topic: 两个非默认服务面：prefill-only 路由在 axum 层强制 max_tokens=1（否则 400）；LoRA 路由要求引擎铸造 control 通道（LoraClient 是能力本身），启动时装载列出的适配器。

learning_goals: 说出 SchedulerMetrics 各字段含义与两类累计计数器（spec_decode、prefix_cache）的语义
解释发布通道两代差异：stepped 引擎写共享单元（MetricsPublisher），legacy 引擎用 watch 通道，changed() 仅在真实变化时唤醒
论证计数器为何必须是累计值：读者只看到最新快照，无法对每步增量求和
lectures.practice_task: 运行 echo-server 并 curl /metrics，尝试定位 scheduler/stats 相关输出（如找不到，对照代码说明 stepped 桥 stats 从 SchedulerHandle::metrics 而来、由上游 recorder 决定导出名）；写出一条前缀缓存命中数（prefix_cache.hits）从调度器到 /metrics 的传播路径，并解释「计数必须是累计值」在代码里的注释依据。
lectures.title: 可观测性：SchedulerMetrics 从调度器到 /metrics
lectures.topic: SchedulerMetrics 是调度器每迭代发布的自画像（KV 块占用、running/waiting、spec-decode 与 prefix-cache 累计计数），经共享单元或 watch 通道到桥的 stats，最终进入 /metrics。

lectures.title: 单元四 · 高级：vLLM 协议栈与对外服务面

learning_goals: 解释 KvPrefix 的三个成员：hit_tokens（退化解析也只是一 个更小的数）、绑定 rank、drop-only 的不透明 hold
走查 RequestEnvelope 的 drop 炸弹：调度器线程消失后新提交仍能拿到 Failed 终态
区分 RequestControl 的 abort 置位路径与调度器的 retire 响应，以及 DeferredFinish 的迟到终态场景
lectures.practice_task: 对 echo-server 发一个 max_tokens 较大的流式请求并中途 Ctrl-C，对照代码指出：abort reason 在哪一层被置位（TokenSink 的原子状态 / stepped 契约的 ledger is_aborted）、调度器在哪个方法里 retire；再写一段话论证「已解析前缀与调用方绑定 rank 不一致」为什么是调用方 bug 而非引擎故障（提示：hold 把块钉在解析时的 rank 上）。
lectures.title: KV 前缀解析与请求控制细节
lectures.topic: 契约边缘的三块硬骨头：KvPrefix 的不透明 RAII hold 与 rank 绑定、RequestEnvelope 的 drop 炸弹与 RequestControl abort、DeferredFinish 与 StopPolicy 的迟到终态。

learning_goals: 按清单复述接入步骤：实现 ModelLine → 注册进 model_lines() → Cargo feature → families() 行 + 单测 → detect_gate 式端到端测试
解释 echo-server.rs 为何是官方参考：一个不含 GPU 的完整模型线（probe + Scheduler + launch + 镜像 main 的服务流程）
说出 detect_gate.rs 的两用 fixture 设计：冻结 config 来自模型 crate，tokenizer 来自 echo-model，两条路径都不触达 CUDA
minimal_modules: server 注册与 families 行
lectures.practice_task: 把 echo-server.rs 复制改造成 Reverse 线：probe 认领 model_type=reverse，调度器把 prompt 逆序逐 token 吐回（改 EchoScheduler 的出队方向），在 examples 或临时 bin 里跑起来，用 /v1/completions 验证输出顺序；随后在草稿中完成剩余清单——给 families() 加 reverse 行、写 hint 单测、仿 detect_gate.rs 写一个针对该二进制的检测门测试。
lectures.title: 从零接入一条新模型线：完整清单
lectures.topic: 把前四单元串成一个可操作清单：在模型 crate 实现 ModelLine、在 server 注册、加 Cargo feature、补 families() 行与提示测试、写 detect_gate 式端到端测试；echo-server.rs 是全程可跑的参考。

learning_goals: 论证纯分发二进制的收益：server 不 import 任何模型的选项类型，新增模型线对 server 的唯一改动是注册一行
界定 feature_gate_hint 的能力边界：identity-only，无法运行被编译掉的 probe，量化变体/绑词嵌入/YaRN 也会命中提示
给出两代契约合并的判据：所有模型线迁到 step 驱动后 LaunchedEngine 可删，ServePlan::default 的扩展约定（CI 编译三条线）是防漂移手段
lectures.practice_task: 写一页设计笔记回答三问：(1) 若把 SharedArgs 拆进各模型 crate，注册表的哪些自检（id/拼写唯一性、consume-or-reject）会失效或变贵；(2) 一个 model_type=qwen3 的量化变体在 stock 构建下会得到什么提示、这个提示在什么意义上是「过度承诺」，依据 families() 的文档注释作答；(3) 删除 LaunchedEngine::Handle 需要哪些前提，当前 main.rs 与 vllm/mod.rs 里哪些分支会随之消失。
lectures.title: 设计取舍复盘：纯分发二进制与契约迁移
lectures.topic: 复盘三个架构决定：server 只做纯分发的代价与收益、families() 作为「必要的第二真相源」的 identity-only 边界、两代引擎契约共存的迁移边界与删除条件。

lectures.title: 单元五 · 专家：扩展、细节与二次开发
